description: If you're wondering why everything seems so typical all of a sudden, it's because you've just sauntered into the office. You decide to just list off a complete list of everything you see in the room, because hey, why not? You see a desk. But oh no! there's nothing on this piece of trash. Aw, here you were, all excited for there to be things on it! There is an open door leading east. You don't like doors? Why not try going north, that entranceway is unblocked. There is an exit to the south. Don't worry, it is unguarded.
